outcome: Neonatal deaths under 24 hours of life
Number of sick newborns transferred from the maternity unit
cohort: Newborns from 68,435 vaginal deliveries and 9,253 cesarean sections in 20 facilities in Madhesh Province, Nepal
finding: The implementation of the Safa Sunaulo Nepal (SSN) model, which included Helping Babies Breathe (HBB) training and skill retention strategies, was associated with significant decreases in neonatal deaths under 24 hours of life, intrapartum stillbirths, and the number of sick newborns transferred from the maternity unit.
